title: Submit-tool description hard-codes the in-flight retry count ("three") instead of deriving it from ACCEPTANCE_EVALUATION_IN_FLIGHT_RETRIES
outcome: The termal_submit_acceptance_evaluation tool description states the in-flight retry bound from the same constant the evaluator brief uses, so the two cannot drift apart.
acceptance: TERMAL_SUBMIT_ACCEPTANCE_EVALUATION_TOOL_DESCRIPTION (acceptance_evaluation_api.rs) states the retry bound derived from ACCEPTANCE_EVALUATION_IN_FLIGHT_RETRIES rather than a hard-coded word; it is built at definition time if a const string cannot interpolate.
The existing brief and tool-description contract test still pins the wording and passes.
